item.text:
Added React view transitions to the product gallery. Each thumbnail and its detail hero now share a product-specific transition name, so the image morphs between routes. Product links slide forward, the back link slides in reverse, and Suspense skeletons animate into content.

Updated Next.js to 16.4.5 and React to 19.3.1 for the required APIs. The styles in [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css) disable these animations and the skeleton pulse when the user prefers reduced motion.

Verification passed: the production build, TypeScript check, and HTTP checks for both routes. Visual motion still depends on browser View Transitions support.
